hero-description:
	I repent of any sin that has distanced me from the Lord, and I turn back to Him with all my heart.
	In the name of Jesus, I renounce any areas of disobedience and rebellion in my life.
	Lord, forgive me for any compromise, Luke warmness, or areas where I have shut You out.
	I ask for Your cleansing and renewing as I humbly return to You. Wash me and make me whole again.
	As I draw near to God, I receive His mercy, grace, and freedom. I am restored and renewed by His love.
